coverImageAlt: An adjustable navy bridge carries a wooden learner figure toward a glowing orange faceted object.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Adaptive tutoring represented by an adjustable bridge whose supports move to meet a learner at the right height and guide progress toward a glowing knowledge form.
Scene/backdrop: A layered warm paper landscape separated by a calm slate channel.
Subject: One small abstract wooden learner figure, a modular navy bridge with adjustable cyan supports, and an orange-lit faceted form at the destination.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; strong crop-safe bridge silhouette; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: patient, encouraging, progressively illuminating
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: abstract featureless figure only; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
